title: Changes in nasal soft tissue morphology following Le Fort I osteotomy of the maxilla: evaluation using a three-dimensional camera
html: This study aimed to investigate the factors affecting alar width after Le Fort I osteotomy. A prospective observational study was conducted on 84 patients who underwent orthodontic treatment followed by Le Fort I osteotomy, with or without bilateral sagittal split ramus osteotomy. Measurements of alar width, alar base width, and nasal tip protrusion were obtained using a three-dimensional camera before surgery and on postoperative days 3, 7, 60, and 90. The sella–nasion–A point (SNA) angle was assessed from lateral cephalometric radiographs to evaluate maxillary movement.
